usage: Components and pages use semantic tokens only (--color-page, --color-primary-foreground, --space-4, --text-body-size ...).
Never use --primitive-* tokens or hardcoded colors, sizes or fonts.
Light/dark is switched by data-theme="light|dark" on <html>; without it the OS preference applies.
Text styles are sets of variables named --text-<style>-<size|line|weight|tracking|style|family>.

tokens.name: size.icon.xl

tokens.name: motion.easing.in-out

tokens.name: motion.scale.popup
tokens.description: Starting scale of anchored popups (menu, select, popover). Never scale(0).

tokens.name: motion.scale.modal
tokens.description: Starting scale of dialogs, which stay centered.

tokens.name: color.page
tokens.description: The page itself. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: color.card
tokens.description: Content blocks on the page: cards, panels, table rows.

tokens.name: color.sunken
tokens.description: Recessed areas: code blocks, wells, inset fields.

tokens.name: color.highlight
tokens.description: Highlighted panel inside a card: a metric, total or goal that should stand out. Lighter than the card in dark, soft gray in light. Never nest a highlight inside another highlight.

tokens.name: color.modal
tokens.description: Layers above the page: dialog, menu, select list, popover.

tokens.name: color.component
tokens.description: Background of interactive controls at rest: inputs, secondary buttons, toggles.

tokens.name: color.component-on-sunken
tokens.description: Component placed on a sunken area, so it still stands out.

tokens.name: color.transparent-hover
tokens.description: Ghost control or list item hovered.

tokens.name: color.transparent-active
tokens.description: Ghost control pressed, or list item selected or highlighted.

tokens.name: color.disabled-foreground
tokens.description: Text and icons of disabled controls.

tokens.name: color.inverted-solid
tokens.description: Primary action background: the main button.

tokens.name: color.brand-solid
tokens.description: Brand background for key actions and selected states.

tokens.name: color.brand-subtle
tokens.description: Soft brand tint behind text or icons.

tokens.name: color.brand-foreground
tokens.description: Brand colored text and icons on the page and cards, derived from --color-brand-solid.

tokens.name: color.brand-foreground-soft
tokens.description: Brand text and icons for tinted surfaces, derived from --color-brand-solid.

tokens.name: color.positive-subtle
tokens.description: Soft positive tint behind text or icons.

tokens.name: color.warning-subtle
tokens.description: Soft warning tint behind text or icons.

tokens.name: color.warning-bright
tokens.description: Brighter, more saturated warning for a tone that must read as yellow, such as an alert icon, title, border and background. The solid step stays darker for text on a solid fill.

tokens.name: color.info-subtle
tokens.description: Soft info tint behind text or icons.

tokens.name: color.danger-subtle
tokens.description: Soft danger tint behind text or icons.

tokens.name: color.danger-subtle-hover
tokens.description: Danger subtle hovered, e.g. destructive menu item.

tokens.name: color.border-default
tokens.description: Default borders: inputs, cards, dividers you can see.

tokens.name: color.brand-border-default
tokens.description: Brand border: selected card, active field.

tokens.name: syntax.text
tokens.description: Default code text: variables, operators, plain identifiers.

tokens.name: syntax.keyword
tokens.description: Language keywords and control flow. Uses the softer brand text so it passes contrast on --color-sunken.

tokens.name: syntax.punctuation
tokens.description: Braces, brackets, separators and other punctuation.

tokens.name: syntax.diff-added-bg
tokens.description: Background of an added line in a diff.

tokens.name: syntax.diff-removed-bg
tokens.description: Background of a removed line in a diff.

tokens.name: shadow.inset-ring
tokens.description: A quiet 1px ring drawn inside the edge, so it never grows the box or reads as a heavy border. Use it on badges, chips and selected states.

tokens.name: shadow.default
tokens.description: A small lift for controls at rest that should feel pressable: slider thumbs, raised buttons, tabs.

tokens.name: shadow.raised
tokens.description: Raised look for secondary controls: inner hairline, top highlight, outer edge and soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow.large
tokens.description: Floating panels anchored to a trigger: menus, select lists, popovers, tooltips and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow.extra-large
tokens.description: Surfaces that sit above the whole page: dialogs and the search palette.
